### New

- **Link actions (#161).** Right-click (desktop) or long-press (phone) a link in a message and the menu targets that link: **Copy link** copies it with tracking parameters stripped — the same URL a click would open — and **Open link** opens it. On a phone there is also **Share link**, and the message sheet gains **Show links**: every link in the message as a tappable list where the WebView's own long-press menu (open / copy address / share) works on each.
- **Message action bar (desktop).** The long vertical message menu is now a compact two-row chip bar anchored to the bubble: quick-reaction emoji on top (the round smiley expands to the full searchable emoji tray), short-label action chips below. It opens by right-click or via a new **⋮** chip that appears next to the Reply pill on hover — which also makes every message action keyboard-reachable for the first time. Read-only chats keep the ⋮ chip even though they have no Reply pill.

### Changes

- **Forward-to picker has a search bar** (#158), with the same simple matching as the chat search and a "No chats match." hint.
- **Add members uses an "Add" picker** (#160) instead of a create-style flow.
- **"Show only known contacts" filter** (#169) on the New chat, Add members, Forward and Contacts surfaces, on by default — known means someone you already have a 1:1 chat with. Untick it to reach the raw contact database (still the path for starting a first chat with a group-only contact).
- **Thread sheet**: Android BACK now closes it (with a scrim and a back-to-chat chevron), and the thread side button stays on the bubble's line on narrow screens.
- **Relays modal**: the sending rows hint that delivery fails over to your other relays, and show per-relay capability flags (chat, attachments, push) from the relay's own metadata.
- **New-group creation fixed** (#151): the Create button could silently do nothing depending on how the picker was opened, and avatar initials now work for Cyrillic and other non-Latin names.

### Fixes

- The thread side button wrapped onto its own line on narrow screens (landed just after 1.4.79 was cut).

### Under the hood

- No core bump: chatmail core 2.65.0 with the 25-op quilt carries over.
- Quilt tooling: verify normalizes CRLF on read; trackers added for upstream #163–#168.
